title: Nice jars
text: Nice jars. Perfect for what we needed for!

product_metadata.title: Folinstall 1 Gallon Glass Jar with Lid, Big Pickle Jar with Airtight Lid, Large Mason Jar for Pickled Eggs, Clear Glass Storage Jar for Kombucha, Limoncello, Sun tea (Extra 1 Gasket)
features: ※【Airtight Lid】- These cookie jars are designed with food grade silica gel seal, which provides an air-tight seal to preserve the freshness of your food items. What’s more, in order to prevent leakage, there is an extra free silicone gasket inside that can be used as an alternative, or can be used together with two stacks.

※【Health and Durability】- Wide-mouth mason jars are a healthier choice over plastic storage jars. Glass does not discolor. These mason jars increase thickness for added durability and stability. What’s more, you can wash these glass jars with warm water, and wipe them with a damp cloth, Dishwasher Safe, BPA Free

※【Multi-Function Jars with Airtight Lids】- 1 gallon glass jars are great for many uses. Can be used for kombucha brewing, sun tea, canning or pickling. Also suited for dry goods such as cereal, legumes, pasta and much more. Not only does it allow you to store different amounts of food, but it looks visually appealing when displayed on a counter or shelf

※【Transparent and Big Mouth Design】- Airtight jars with hinged lids allow the contents of the coffee jar to be easily seen without removing the lid. The glass canister features a large mouth (3.3 inches) and concave neck that makes filling and storing preserves with ease, so you don’t have to worry about spilling sauces or pickled vegetables after the Christmas cookie jar is opened

※【Food grade glass】 This glass canister with lids is made of ultra-thickness glass, BPA-free and lead-free, 100% reusable. Easy to clean, just clean it with a little water, it is dishwasher safe (Lids not recommended in the dishwasher).
